lines: Author: Dr M. Ellerscombe, Senior In Vitro Biologist

blocks.p: This note hands over the biology items I am carrying on the hERG channel screen and the control-lot checks before my last week. Items I have not closed are listed in section 5. Where a decision is still open I have left the placeholder rather than guess at it.
The note is for Leila and Ravi. Leila has seen the first version only.

Check run acceptance before interpreting any compound. A failed E-4031 control places the affected run on hold. Investigate the failure and repeat the affected work under the assay protocol; keep the original sample card and test-lot identity linked to the repeat.

list: Hold results from runs that fail the E-4031 acceptance window

list.text: Check cell-quality flags separately; exclude invalid cells under the protocol and repeat when too few accepted cells remain

list: Document the repeat conditions and the link to the original run
Repeat count per compound: [TBC] (I have not agreed this with Gerda and Ravi)

blocks.p: Retain both original and repeat records. Report accepted results under the protocol, preserving censoring and any qualifications; do not choose a repeat merely because its result is preferred. The study director resolves discordant accepted runs.
The control-lot check is still unresolved. Confirm the lot history and whether a bridging comparison is required before releasing any affected screening sets. I have not closed this review.

If bridging is required, compare reference responses under matched assay conditions
